sensor.name: CUST - Tanium Client folder size Friendly
sensor.description: Returns the folder size of the Tanium Client install folder in GB, round up with only one digit decimal.

sensor_query.query:
import tanium import os
def get_size(start_path = tanium.client.get_client_dir()): total_size = 0 for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(start_path): for f in filenames: fp = os.path.join(dirpath, f) total_size += os.path.getsize(fp)
return total_size
size=float(get_size()) / (2**20) / 1000 tanium.results.add(round(size,1))
